inputs: how do I fix a leaking tap

replies: A dripping tap is nearly always a worn washer or cartridge: turn the water off at the isolating valve under the sink, take the handle off, and take the old part to a hardware shop to match it. It's a 20-minute job and saves a lot of water.

inputs: how often should I water a cactus

replies: Water a cactus every two to three weeks in summer, and barely at all from November to March. Soak it, let it dry right out, and never leave the pot standing in water: more cacti die of watering than of neglect.

For about 12 thin pancakes, whisk 100g plain flour, 2 eggs and 300ml milk with a pinch of salt, then let the batter rest 20 minutes. Cook them in a hot non-stick pan with a little butter, about a minute a side, until bubbles pop on top and the edges look dry. The rest is what stops them tearing; American ones want a teaspoon of baking powder and a thicker batter. Flat ones are a batter that was too thin, or an old raising agent.

inputs: how long can cooked chicken stay in the fridge

replies: Cooked chicken or turkey keeps 3 days in the fridge in a covered box, and freezes for up to 3 months. Cool it within 2 hours of cooking, reheat it once until it is piping hot all through, and eat it cold only if it went straight into the fridge.
